opening.argument: The segment presents Bill Nye answering science questions, not asking viewers to take part in a transaction. He introduces it as another installment of Science Support and then addresses questions about how planes work and how a solar sail spacecraft could be used to watch for asteroids. Those examples fit the broader discussion of oceans, teleportation, thermodynamics, and space exploration: the content explains and considers scientific concepts in an episodic educational format. Nothing in the described segment requests payment, credentials, investment participation, or another deceptive action. The evidence supports an educational purpose without establishing any such solicitation.

citations.quote: Bill Nye Answers Science Questions From Twitter - Part 3 | Tech Support | WIRED
